title: Griffin’s Move Offers AI Reprieve as Traders Eye More Blowouts
title_zh: 随着交易员看到更多井喷，格里芬的举动为人工智能提供了喘息之机
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Billionaire Ken Griffin’s rescue of hedge fund Situational Awareness helped trigger a relief rally in global AI stocks, leaving traders debating if the worst is over or more blowouts are on the way.Most Read from BloombergSingapore's Gated Island for the Rich Is...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——亿万富翁肯·格里芬 (Ken Griffin) 对对冲基金态势感知的救助引发了全球人工智能股票的缓解性反弹，让交易员们争论最坏的情况是否已经过去，还是更多的井喷即将到来。

title: Evercore Q2 Earnings Miss Estimates, Revenues Rise on Deal Activity
title_zh: Evercore 第二季度收益未达预期，收入因交易活动而增长
summary: EVR posts record Q2 revenues on stronger deal activity and higher AUM, but rising expenses and special charges weighed on earnings.
summary_zh: 由于交易活动增强和资产管理规模增加，EVR 第二季度收入创历史新高，但费用和特殊费用的增加对收益造成了压力。

title: Anthropic-Meta AI Deal in the Cards? ETFs in Focus
